faq_heading: Clayton condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Clayton. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Clayton, Cloverdale: 96 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 20 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 21%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 3 Cloverdale communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Cloverdale total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Clayton fell from 108 in June to 96 in September (−11.1%), and 96 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 49.5% of Cloverdale’s 194 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Clayton?
Clayton also had 34 houses listed and 10 sold in September, against 96 condos and townhomes listed. The Clayton houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Clayton?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 96 condos and townhomes listed in Clayton. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Clayton a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Clayton had a sales ratio of 21%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Clayton from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 96 condos and townhomes sold in Clayton over those 4 months, out of 165 in all of Cloverdale.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
